title: 第10章 还清欠账-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》
content:
第(1/3)页

    吴姜一路嘎嘎怪笑着，身形轻得像一阵清风，从苍名县最大的洗浴中心飘了出来，脸上的笑意就没断过，心里乐开了花，多年夙愿，今朝总算得偿所愿了！

    他一边飘，一边在心里美滋滋地嘀咕：“虽说这大半夜的人少，可架不住质量高啊，这一趟没白来，值了！”

    一路哼着不成调的小曲，吴姜飘得飞快，没一会儿就折返了爷爷家的房间。

    看着床上自己安安静静躺着的肉身，他连忙收敛心神，不再耽搁，身形一晃，稳稳当当融入了肉身之中。

    阴魂归位的瞬间，熟悉的温热气流如期而至，顺着经脉缓缓游走，浑身都暖洋洋的，先前催动魂力留下的疲惫感一扫而空，体内的魂力，也比之前又充盈了一丝，肉眼可见地有了小进步。

    “舒服！”吴姜伸了个大大的懒腰，一脸惬意地呻吟出声，浑身的骨头都跟着咯吱响了一下。

    只是，还没等他高兴多久，一阵熟悉的悸动又传了过来。

    “今天的任务这么多吗？”吴姜好奇的想着，随手召出了阴差令牌。

    指尖一点，一条惩处信息浮现在了脑海。

    “三等鬼差吴姜，任职期间，恶意偷窥阳间凡人隐私，特予以惩罚，扣除贡献点100！如有再犯，将加倍处罚，绝不姑息！”

    吴姜楞在了原处，眼睛瞪得溜圆，像被雷劈了似的，愣了足足三四秒，才猛地反应过来，忍不住爆了粗口：“我靠！不是吧？！这也扣贡献点？阴差守则上也没写这条啊？玩我呢？！”

    他一脸崩溃地瘫倒在床上，四肢摊开，欲哭无泪。

    刚爽没两分钟，欠的贡献点窟窿反倒越捅越大了，这要是让城隍老祖宗知道了，不知道会不会一道雷劈死他！

    只是，地府的惩罚已经生效了，他就算再不满，也只能认栽。

    本来积攒了一身的火气，还想着回家以后，看看老师的视频去去火，这下什么心情都没有了。

    第二天一早，吴姜顶着一脸的郁闷起床，习惯性地打开冰箱，结果一看，冰箱里的快乐水都断货了。

    吴姜撇了撇嘴，拿起钱包，刚准备出门去便利店“进货”，一打开房门，就撞见邻居大姐姐也正好下楼。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wu Jiang was laughing strangely all the way, his figure was as light as a breeze, and he floated out from the largest bathing center in Cangming County. The smile on his face never stopped, and he felt happy in his heart. His long-cherished wish for many years was finally fulfilled!

As he floated, he muttered happily in his heart: "Although there are few people in the middle of the night, the quality is high. This trip is not in vain, it is worth it!"

Humming a tuneless tune all the way, Wu Jiang drifted very fast, and soon returned to his grandpa's room.

Looking at his body lying peacefully on the bed, he quickly gathered his thoughts and without any further delay, his figure swayed and steadily merged into his body.

The moment the ghost returned to its place, the familiar warm air arrived as expected and slowly traveled along the meridians. The whole body was warm. The fatigue left by the previous stimulation of the soul power was swept away. The soul power in the body was also fuller than before, and there was a small improvement visible to the naked eye.

"Comfortable!" Wu Jiang stretched out and groaned with a contented look on his face, and all the bones in his body creaked.

However, before he could be happy for long, a familiar throbbing came over him again.

"Are there so many tasks today?" Wu Jiang thought curiously and summoned the Yin difference token.

With a click of your fingertips, a punishment message appeared in your mind.

"Wu Jiang, a third-class ghost officer, maliciously peeped into the privacy of mortals during his tenure. He will be specially punished and 100 contribution points will be deducted! If he commits the crime again, the punishment will be doubled and will not be tolerated!"

Wu Jiang was stunned at the same place, his eyes widened, as if he had been struck by lightning. He was stunned for three or four seconds, and then he suddenly reacted and couldn't help but cursed: "Holy crap! Isn't it?! This also deducts contribution points? There is no such thing in the code of evil? Are you kidding me?!"

He collapsed on the bed with a collapsed face, his limbs spread out, and he wanted to cry without tears.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​         The hole in the unpaid contribution is getting bigger and bigger. If the ancestor of the City God knew about this, I wonder if he would be struck to death by lightning!

However, the punishment from the underworld has already taken effect. No matter how dissatisfied he is, he can only admit defeat.

I had accumulated a lot of anger, and I thought about watching the teacher’s videos to relieve it when I got home, but now I was in no mood at all.

Early the next morning, Wu Jiang got up with a depressed look on his face and opened the refrigerator out of habit. As a result, he saw that all the happy water in the refrigerator was out of stock.

Wu Jiang curled his lips, picked up his wallet, and was about to go out to the convenience store to "restock". As soon as he opened the door, he saw his neighbor's sister coming downstairs.
